data.name: Pretty Pink Boat - Seaforth Boat Rental
data.headline: Book Online or Call the Boat Rental Office at 619-223-1681
data.description:
Please read below for rental details.

WE LOVE YOUR CUTE HEELS BUT FOR YOUR SAFETY PLEASE WEAR FLAT SHOES FOR YOUR CHARTER!

The Pretty Pink Boat is a total head turner and the envy of everyone on the shore. The free photo booth* allows guests to take group photos you receive directly to your phones to share with friends onshore. With a built-in Photobooth, Bluetooth Audio System, Lounging Areas, Coolers, and everything pink…this boat is a serious vibe! Rent the boat and hire a captain to experience the unique Pretty Pink Boat experience.

*Note that the photo booth is a free service on board. While we attempt to retrieve all photos when possible, receiving pictures is not guaranteed in the case of technical or mechanical issues.

A US Coast Guard captain’s license is required for this vessel.

meeting_point.address: 1641 QUIVIRA RD San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_is_included: The listed rate does not include the cost for a USCG Licensed captain to drive the boat for you. Per federal law we cannot select a captain for you, but would be happy to introduce you to a choice of local skippers who are qualified to operate the boat. The hired captain will be paid directly at the time of the rental and usually charge $50 per hour.
data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Hired captains will charge $50/hour + gratuity, paid directly in cash to the captain that you have hired.
Food & drinks are welcome on board. Please avoid red wine, hard liquor and glass bottles.  Drugs, including marijuana, are strictly prohibited. 

**WE LOVE YOUR CUTE HEELS BUT FOR YOUR SAFETY PLEASE WEAR FLAT SHOES FOR YOUR CHARTER!**
data.disclaimers:
**NO Drugs, Hard Liquor, Red Wine, or Glass Containers allowed. Please drink responsibly and be over 21 years old. Rentals with overly intoxicated party members will be cancelled. Drivers must refrain from any alcohol consumption
**Renter's ID and matching payment credit card must be presented upon checkin. Must be 18+ to rent.
**Max passenger capacity is 12. This includes all children.
**Onsite parking can be limited. Please carpool if you can. We have a parking lot and street parking available, but please allow ample time if you choose to drive. Arrive at least 30 mins early for check in.
